wat321.enableClaude.markdownDescription: Enable Claude widgets (usage bars and session tokens). Widgets hide automatically when Claude Code is not installed.

wat321.enableCodex.markdownDescription: Enable Codex widgets (usage bars and session tokens). Widgets hide automatically when the Codex CLI is not installed.

wat321.enableOpenCode.markdownDescription:
**Enable OpenCode** widgets and the managed `opencode serve` for free routable models (Big Pickle, MiniMax M2.5 Free, Ling 2.6 Flash Free, Hy3 Preview Free, Nemotron 3 Super Free). Auto-spawns a serve subprocess so Claude and your tool-using harness can dispatch against any catalog instance, including your local LLM. Unloads automatically when VS Code closes. Hidden automatically when the OpenCode CLI is not installed (`npm i -g opencode-ai`).

**Data usage on free models.** Per OpenCode's docs, during the free period collected data may be used to improve the model. Nemotron 3 Super Free additionally has prompts and outputs logged by NVIDIA. If you don't want training-eligible traffic, disable this and use Claude/Codex/your local LLM only.

wat321.notifications.mode.markdownDescription: Notify you when Claude or Codex finishes a response.

wat321.notifications.claude.markdownDescription: Show notifications for Claude sessions. Requires Claude to be enabled.

wat321.notifications.codex.markdownDescription: Show notifications for Codex sessions. Requires Codex to be enabled.

enumDescriptions: Automatic - Full when only one provider is active, Compact when both are active
Full usage widgets with compact session tokens
Compact progress bars (5 blocks), slim session tokens
Text-only status bar, progress bars move to tooltips on hover
wat321.displayMode.markdownDescription: Status bar display density. Auto adjusts based on how many providers are active. **Full + Compact** keeps usage widgets at full size while shrinking session-token labels - useful when the status bar is full and you want to free space without losing usage detail.

wat321.enableHeatmap.markdownDescription: Enable heatmap colors on the usage progress bar. The bars gradually shift through warning colors as you get closer to your limits so tight sessions stand out at a glance.

wat321.statusBarPriority.markdownDescription: Base priority for WAT321 status bar items. Higher values appear further left. Adjust if widgets overlap with other extensions. *Requires window reload.*

wat321.epicHandshake.enabled.markdownDescription:
**Enable Epic Handshake** - Lets you say things like *"Ask Codex to review this"*, *"Have Big Pickle check this"*, or *"Use the Local LLM to scrape this"* in any Claude session using natural language. WAT321 runs a small local two-way bridge that delivers responses straight back to your Claude session.

Requires Claude plus Codex and/or OpenCode. Activation fails when neither Codex CLI nor OpenCode CLI is installed.

After you turn this on, any active Claude sessions will need to be restarted so they can use the bridge. New sessions pick it up automatically. Bridge can be paused by clicking on the Epic Handshake status bar and selecting **Pause** from the top of the dropdown.

wat321.epicHandshake.suppressCodexNotifi.markdownDescription: Suppress Codex completion notifications while the Epic Handshake bridge is active. You still get the Claude notification when Claude finishes integrating the reply, so there's no silent delivery - this just avoids two back-to-back notifications for the same exchange. Turn this off if you want Codex notifications regardless.

wat321.localEndpoint.markdownDescription:
URL for your local LLM server. You can have one installed directly on this computer or on a server on your local network.

**Empty (default):** leave empty if you don't have a local LLM running.

**Examples:**
- `http://127.0.0.1:8080` - installed directly on this computer
- `http://10.0.0.101:8080` - running on a server on your local network

wat321.clearAllData.markdownDescription: **Reset WAT321** - Restore WAT321 to its defaults and clear everything it has stored locally. If any WAT321 tool appears unresponsive, this will reset all to a known-good state. A confirmation dialog will appear before resetting.
